The checkpoint digest is corrected: the old local copy was UTF-8 decoded as code page437, with CRLF conversion and a final newline. That transformation reproduces the erroneous digest exactly; the authoritative GitHub bytes and original assessment/receipt are preserved.

Native chooser proof remains missing with no applicable waiver. The owner/coordinator should also reconcile issue438's stale review-pending status line. Unchanged source, CI and browser evidence were reverified without rerunning suites or captures.

[Immutable superseding assessment and correction](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/1fe117f29d9a5b578217b963a5c685084b82894d/pr439-qa/followup-20261007/verdict.json). No source, readiness or draft changes.
